_doc: Pre-registered contents of each Harness² archive (GAPS 'Harness² pilot pre-registration', 'Phase 2 pre-registration', 'Phase 2 amendment'). Committed before any Harness² rollout exists; the verifier (eval/analysis/verify_h2_archive.py) checks every task and rollout listed here. Harness² k=1 schedules 4 rollouts per task (1 base reference + 2 probes + 1 composition); a sweep that ends with a BudgetStop is complete for the tasks its budget-stop record lists as finished.
